pages.title: Herbalist Hut
pages.text: A secluded workshop found in $(bold)Swamp$() and $(bold)Mangrove Swamp$() biomes. An early source of herbs, crops, and farming materials for aspiring witches.

pages.title: Where to Find
pages.text: Look for a small, weathered cabin partially hidden by vegetation in Swamps. Infused soil nearby supports the growth of herbs and crops.

pages.title: Contents
pages.text: The hut contains a variety of magical flora and early resources, including herbs and cultivated crops ready for harvesting.

pages.title: On Discovery
pages.text: Herbalist Huts provide a natural introduction to Hexalia's systems, offering enough materials to begin experimenting with rituals, brewing, and cultivation.
